get.description: Same-origin Secure HttpOnly cookie EventSource. Origin may be absent when Sec-Fetch-Site is same-origin; no custom CSRF or X-Requested-With header. Cursor is the opaque SSE id (user UUID:sequence); Last-Event-ID takes precedence over after. Invalid, foreign, ahead or expired cursors receive a generic reset with this user's current cursor and the stream closes. GET original persisted resources after reset; never POST a replacement task. Default transport retention is 7 days; permanent sequence and deduplication receipts are retained. Unstored fragments have no id and cannot be replayed. Real upstream streaming is disabled pending D-01. Redis is unnecessary for correctness.
